title: The Sound of Silence: reading by shape

blocks.text:
A song you know well, in a range you'll use a lot: from middle C up. Its tune climbs by skips, which is the skill this lesson trains.

**By the end** you can read middle C to D on the treble staff and play bars 3–6 with both hands.

blocks.caption: The Sound of Silence, a piano arrangement (PDMX). ▶ to hear it.

blocks.text:
# Middle C and up
Below the treble staff: **middle C** on its own ledger line, **D** just under the bottom line. Then **E** on the bottom line, **F** in the bottom space, **G** on the second line, **A** in the second space, **B** on the middle line, **C** in the third space, **D** on the fourth line.

blocks.title: Middle C up to D
blocks.doneWhen: 16 of the 20 cards clean in one set

blocks.text:
# Climbing by skips
The tune of bar 3 goes **D D F F A A**, then G: each pair a skip higher, line to line or space to space. Bar 5 is the same shape from C: **C C E E G G**, then F. Bar 7 again from F: **F F A A C C**. Read the first note and the shape, not every letter.

The tune is eighth notes (two to a beat) and half notes, and each phrase starts after a beat's rest.

blocks.title: The tune, right hand
blocks.about: Wait for me, right hand, bars 3–7.

blocks.text:
# The left hand: a chord, one note at a time
The left hand plays the notes of a chord one after another, low to high and back: in bar 3 **D A F A**, twice. Bars 5–6 are **C G E G**. Each pattern is the three notes of a chord (D F A, then C E G). The key signature has one flat, B♭, but no B comes in these bars.

blocks.title: The left hand
blocks.about: Wait for me, left hand, bars 3–6.

blocks.title: Reading in time
blocks.about: Optional: made-up tunes from middle C, one after another with the click.

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **You start the tune on the beat.** Each phrase starts after a quarter rest.
- **You read every letter.** Find the first note, then follow the skips.

**Until the next lesson:** the tune and the left hand, each day.
